detail.longDescription: TIL about the existence of IzzyOnDroid a fast repo for Open Source Android apps which scans github repos automatically and thus gives you built apps faster than fdroid. I found IzzyDroid via catima.app which was mentioned to me a couple of days ago. sources: https:// apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/ https:// catima.app/ https:// catima.app/faq Thanks to the power of the FediVerse # IzzyDroid # catima # fdroid # programming # github # repo # sources # binaries # OpenSource
